Sample Text Document
====================

This is a simple plain text document for testing purposes.

The document parser should be able to:
- Read the file content
- Count words and characters
- Handle different encodings

Technical Details
-----------------
- File Type: Plain Text
- Encoding: UTF-8
- Purpose: Unit Testing

Korean Text Sample (한글 샘플)
-----------------------------
이것은 한글 텍스트 샘플입니다.
문서 파서가 한글을 올바르게 처리하는지 테스트합니다.

End of Document
